## Problem

What is the use case or pain point? Describe the situation you are in and what you wish the dashboard did.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to see. Be specific if you can — UI sketch, API shape, env var name, etc.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about. Why are they less good than the proposed solution?

## Additional context

Screenshots, links to similar tools, related issues, anything else.
